entries.title: DRAFT: degree factor in the C0047 spectral criterion
entries.statement: DRAFT source-backed correction, pending referee check. In an infinite connected d-regular Cayley graph let rho be the normalized simple-random-walk spectral radius, so the adjacency norm is d*rho. The classical sufficient condition for bond nonuniqueness is p_c*d*rho<1: choose a supercritical p with p*d*rho<1, bound the connection kernel by the all-walk Neumann series, and exclude uniqueness by FKG. The degree-free p_c<1/rho condition in C0047-A001 is automatic when 0<rho<1 and p_c<=1, and is not that sufficient theorem. The correct condition is not necessary: on T4, p_c=1/3, rho=sqrt(3)/2 and p_u=1, while p_c*d*rho>1. This correction does not solve C0047.

entries.title: DRAFT: overlapping generator paths are not iid
entries.statement: DRAFT refuted-route record, pending referee check. Under iid Bernoulli(p) bond percolation on Cay(F(a,b),{a,a^-1,b,b^-1}), let A and B indicate all-open routes (e,a,a^2) and (e,a,ab). For 0<p<1, P(A)=P(B)=p^2 and P(A and B)=p^3. Compared with iid Bernoulli(p^2) indicators the intersection probability is larger, while the union probability 2p^2-p^3 is smaller than 2p^2-p^4. Thus neither stochastic domination direction holds with that iid law. Replacing added-generator edges by overlapping paths cannot retain iid p^2 solely from its marginals.

entries.title: DRAFT: independent slots repair path routing with a probability penalty
entries.statement: DRAFT candidate bridge, not a certified theorem. Let G,H be countable connected locally finite simple undirected graphs on the same vertex set. Fix for every H-edge h a simple G-path P_h joining its endpoints, with length <=L, and suppose each G-edge lies in <=M routes, for integers L,M>=1. For p in [0,1], set t=1-(1-p)^(1/M), q=t^L. Assign distinct independent Bernoulli(t) slots to routes at every base edge; OR M slots to realize iid G-percolation at p, and independently thin shorter route indicators to obtain iid H-percolation at q. This couples every H-open route inside a G-open path, hence p_c^bond(G)<=1-(1-(p_c^bond(H))^(1/L))^M. The written countable-product proof in bridge_derivation.md awaits w563. This transfers existence only; different H-clusters may merge in G.
assumptions: Connected locally finite simple undirected graphs

entries.title: DRAFT: exact remaining C0047 bridge premises
entries.statement: DRAFT missing-premise record. For the prescribed Cayley graph, bounded critical connection operator T_{p_c} on counting-measure l2 would yield a strict operator interval above p_c via Russo/BK continuation; uniqueness is excluded there by FKG. The w561 packet proves this conditional implication but does not establish the critical bound. A September 24, 2026 public manuscript states the critical bound in Theorem 1.1 and every fixed finite symmetric generating set in Corollary 1.2; its 53-page proof is not certified by this packet. In the distinct bounded-congestion routing approach, the missing step is prevention of extra base-open edges merging the infinite routed clusters. Current openness is UNKNOWN here; no parent-solved or novelty claim.
